decisions.diagnosis: Dir 27 sensor fault: first a near-total dropout, then a week in which it also registers the northbound (dir 28) riders, roughly doubling its count.
decisions.evidence: Feb 8-14: dir 27 0-16/day against dir 28 49-94/day. Feb 15-21: dir 27 134-219/day against dir 28 63-108 (usual ratio about 1:1), with a PM peak of 28.6/h at 16h mirroring dir 28 (dir 27's normal PM level is 2-3/h), not all-even. Dir 27 median speed was 10-15 against its usual 7 for the whole episode, and everything returned to normal on Feb 22.

summary: Single piezo counter (149) on the Browns Waterhole shared path, 2011-07 to 2018-02, with clean one-record data and an even directional split. Two dir-27 sensor faults (Feb 8-21 2013, including a week of double registration of northbound riders, and Dec 27 2013-Jan 2 2014) are set missing, as is the partial installation day. Many zero_outage flags covered real near-zero riding on storm/flood days, confirmed by the other direction and neighbouring counters, and are restored; the one-direction overnight flags and the 2017-05-19..26 counter outage are left as the automatic fix set them.
